# Paperglow

Paperglow is a warm, paper-like theme with a daylight palette the description likens to sun-aged pages and a night palette of deep midnight bookroom tones. It uses one typographic stack of Montserrat, Noto Sans SC and JetBrains Mono, a card-style reading container, terracotta accent lines, rounded corners and low-contrast visuals.

![Paperglow screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudy-liu/Paperglow-Theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Paperglow"
    author: "cloudy-liu"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]

Use a unified Montserrat/Noto Sans SC/JetBrains Mono typography, card-style reading container, terracotta accent lines, soft rounded corners and low-contrast visuals to keep focus on text."
}
```
